summary: The games hub: all 21 browser games on one mobile-first page, Turkish and English, each with its animated banner, its own card and a Play button. Rendered from merkez/oyunlar.json by merkez/olustur.py.
key_features: All 21 games at a glance, each shown by its own animated banner
One card per game in its own colours and motif, with how to play and a Play button
Turkish by default, English with the TR/EN switch or ?lang=en; no trackers
Re-rendered by the Merkez workflow whenever merkez/oyunlar.json changes

social.headline: Every repository on the account, in one searchable page, generated from the metadata each one carries.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; no field is generated from a guess
